title: RecordResponse
description: What every connector returns (PRD FR-4); the evidence chain stores it as-is. aa_mock returns one RecordResponse per depository, so a FAILED depository is visible to the full-coverage rule. sha256 is over the canonical JSON of payload (sorted keys, no spaces).

source.description: Connector name, with the depository for aa_mock (e.g. aa_mock:CDSL).

consent_id.description: Set for consented fetches (AA); null for public lists.

mock.description: true when the source is a mock (AA, Suspect Registry, @valid lookup, footage).
